notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard directed-interaction delivery. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies target routing, parameter/tag/transport/producer metadata, suppression and release of receiveDirectedInteraction callbacks, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with publishObjectClassDirectedInteractions/registerObjectInstance/sendDirectedInteraction and FederateAmbassador receiveDirectedInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and directed-interaction declarations
